name: reconciliation-engine-poc
description: Invoice-to-bank reconciliation proof of concept (Node.js/TypeScript API + Angular dashboard)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:demo
